articles.title: ohDEER Launches First Maine Locations, Expanding All-Natural Tick, Mosquito and Deer Control to the Pine Tree State
articles.mainIdea: ohDEER Launches First Maine Locations, Expanding All-Natural Tick, Mosquito and Deer Control to the Pine Tree State
articles.summary: PR Newswire: ohDEER Launches First Maine Locations, Expanding All-Natural Tick, Mosquito and Deer Control to the Pine Tree State. ohDEER, a leading provider of all-natural deer, rabbit, tick and mosquito control, is expanding its footprint in New England with the launch of its first two franchise locations in Maine. The new territories will serve homeowners across southern Maine, including the Portland region and surrounding communities.

articles.title: IRS warns taxpayers about fake tax calculators promising big refunds
articles.mainIdea: IRS warns taxpayers about fake tax calculators promising big refunds
articles.summary: Detroit Free Press: IRS warns taxpayers about fake tax calculators promising big refunds. The IRS is warning that scammers may try to trick taxpayers by making false promises about eligibility for new or expanded tax credits and deductions.
